name: Lemon chickpea bowls
description: Crispy chickpeas, cool cucumber, and a bright lemon-herb dressing make a satisfying bowl for any day.
imageAlt: Colorful grain bowl topped with fresh vegetables and herbs
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Pat the chickpeas dry, toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper, then roast for 20 minutes until crisp.
Stir the yogurt with lemon juice, dill, a pinch of salt, and a splash of water until spoonable.
Divide the warm rice, cucumber, and tomatoes between bowls. Add the chickpeas and finish with the lemon-herb dressing.

name: Tomato butter beans
description: Creamy beans simmered in garlicky tomato sauce with wilted greens and plenty of crusty bread.
imageAlt: Warm tomato and bean stew served in a bowl
steps: Warm the olive oil in a deep skillet over medium heat. Add the garlic and smoked paprika and stir for 30 seconds.
Pour in the tomatoes and broth. Add the beans, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Fold in the spinach until just wilted. Serve warm with toasted crusty bread.

name: Ginger salmon tray
description: A sweet-savory ginger glaze brings salmon, broccoli, and fluffy rice together with barely any cleanup.
imageAlt: Glazed salmon fillet served with vegetables
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Whisk together the ginger, soy sauce, honey, and rice vinegar.
Arrange the salmon and broccoli on a lined sheet pan. Spoon the glaze over the salmon and roast for 12–15 minutes, until the fish flakes easily.
Serve over warm rice and spoon any pan juices over the top. Finish with sesame seeds.

name: Green goddess toast
description: A creamy herby spread, ripe avocado, and crunchy seeds turn a quick breakfast into a little ritual.
imageAlt: Avocado toast with fresh greens on toasted bread
steps: Toast the sourdough until golden and crisp.
Mash the cottage cheese with parsley, chives, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt. Spread generously over the toast.
Slice the avocado over each piece. Scatter with pumpkin seeds, chili flakes, and a little black pepper.

name: Crispy chicken couscous
description: Golden spiced chicken, fluffy couscous, and a quick cucumber salad make a fresh, filling supper.
imageAlt: Roasted chicken dinner with fresh vegetables
steps: Rub the chicken with cumin, coriander, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Sear in a hot skillet for 5–6 minutes per side, until the thickest part reaches 165°F (74°C).
Put the couscous in a bowl with a pinch of salt. Pour over 1 cup of boiling water, cover for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork and lemon zest.
Mix the yogurt with lemon juice. Slice the cucumber and serve everything together with the lemon yogurt.

name: Peach oat crumble
description: Juicy peaches bake under a crisp, cinnamon-scented oat topping for a simple dessert to share.
imageAlt: Fresh baked fruit dessert with a golden oat topping
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Toss the sliced peaches with lemon juice and spread in a small baking dish.
Rub the oats, flour, brown sugar, cinnamon, and cold butter together with your fingertips until crumbly. Scatter over the peaches.
Bake for 25 minutes until bubbling and golden. Let rest for 5 minutes and serve with vanilla yogurt.
